chk_problem.label: accurate
chk_problem.poster_evidence: Women’s health remains under-resourced in medical imaging research. Pelvic pathologies like PCOS and pelvic fracture lack public, well-annotated datasets despite clinical importance.
chk_problem.reason: The poster accurately identifies the scarcity of public, well-annotated benchmark data for pelvic pathologies in women's health, matching the reference.

chk_method.label: accurate
chk_method.poster_evidence: PelviNeXt is a modality-agnostic hybrid architecture applied identically to ultrasound and X-ray. It consists of: (1) Dense Feature Extractor (DFE) with 4 dense blocks (6,12,24,16 layers) inspired by DenseNet, producing multi-scale feature maps; (2) Hierarchical CBAM (H-CBAM) after each DFE block, applying channel and spatial attention at 4 scales (56×56 to 7×7); (3) Multi-Scale Fusion Module (MSFM) aligning and fusing outputs of DFE-2,3,4 to 7×7, reducing to 512 channels; (4) Talking-Heads Multi-Head Self-Attention (TH-MHSA) with head-mixing projections before/after softmax for global context; (5) Classification head.
chk_method.reason: The poster provides a detailed description of PelviNeXt's architecture, including its components, matching the reference text.

chk_data.label: accurate
chk_data.poster_evidence: Original PCOSGen (4,668 images: 1,319 Normal, 3,349 Abnormal) reduced to 225 images (63 Normal, 162 Abnormal) — a 95.2% reduction. PXR150 (150 X-rays: 100 fracture, 50 normal) is used as-is.
chk_data.reason: The poster specifies the deduplicated PCOSGen dataset and the PXR150 dataset, matching the reference.

chk_setup.label: accurate
chk_setup.poster_evidence: Training uses AdamW, batch size 16, 30 epochs, 5-fold CV with augmentation (rotation, shear, flip, translate) and class-aware multipliers.
chk_setup.reason: The poster describes the training setup, including optimizer, batch size, epochs, and cross-validation protocol, matching the reference.

chk_primary_result.label: accurate
chk_primary_result.poster_evidence: On deduplicated PCOSGen, PelviNeXt achieves 92.00% accuracy (±1.60), 91.74% recall, 86.48% specificity, 0.8890 F1, and 0.9051 AUROC. On PXR150, PelviNeXt achieves 87.33% accuracy (±2.45), 89.00% recall, 87.00% specificity, 0.8774 F1, and 0.8920 AUROC.
chk_primary_result.reason: The poster reports the primary results for both datasets, including accuracy and AUROC, matching the reference values.

chk_conclusion.label: accurate
chk_conclusion.poster_evidence: PelviNeXt is the first modality-agnostic architecture validated on both pelvic ultrasound and X-ray without task-specific tuning. This work advances reliable, generalizable AI for under-researched women’s pelvic health.
chk_conclusion.reason: The poster concludes that PelviNeXt is a reliable, modality-agnostic foundation for pelvic imaging, matching the reference.
